title: Software QA Engineer
description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.

Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

Renesas is hiring a Software QA Engineer with strong software and hardware testing experience to work with hands-on automated and manual testing of customer-facing software/hardware integrations. Develop and execute detailed manual and automated software/UI test cases in Python or other OO language. Experience in electrical engineering, Hardware debugging, hardware/firmware or embedded testing is strongly desired.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to validate market-leading digital controller solutions powering AI, client, and server applications. Responsibilities include software test planning, execution, reporting, leading testing projects, automation, documentation, and debugging software connected to hardware to determine the root cause of issues, and driving product quality across the development software/hardware lifecycle.
Job responsibilities in QA Testing: 
You will work teams across the globe to generate test requirements and define test methodologies.
- Develop a robust understanding of detailed technical requirements for product software and related hardware and firmware.
- Design and execute automated and manual test plans for software, hardware, firmware, and IC solutions.
- Debug software and hardware issues, with a focus on IC functionality and root cause analysis.
- Analyze test results, report defects, and support issue resolution with development and customer-facing teams.
- Collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to ensure product quality exceeds expectations.
- Drive test automation, validation framework improvements, and QA best practices.
- Mentor team members and contribute to testing strategy, planning, and process enhancements.
- Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while balancing quality, timelines, and feature delivery.
- Proactively identify risks, raise issues, and recommend product and process improvements.

Education: Bachelor's or master's degree in computer engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or similar 
Experience: 2-5 years of Software QA experience, including 2+ years testing software integrated with hardware/firmware.
Technical Proficiency:
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with a keen attention to detail to debug complex HW/SW issues and document detailed test plans and test cases and root cause analysis of software vs hardware/FW bugs through deep analysis of both manual automated test failures.
- Experience in electronics, microcontroller programming, and bus communications, ideally in power systems, semiconductors, or ICs.
- GUI test automation skills with Python and tools such as Qt Squish, SmartBear Test Complete, or similar.
- Familiarity with lab test equipment and measurement tools.
- Solid understanding of JIRA, version control, QA best practices, and software/hardware development lifecycles.
- Proven ability to mentor teams, hardware/software test development and lab management, improve test coverage, and drive quality initiatives.
- Willingness to speak up, raise issues and risks, ask lots of questions, and provide improvement recommendations for products, test cases, test automation, and team processes. 
- Background in both Software QA and IC/Power Engineering preferred.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.
At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.
We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.
Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

title: Senior Supplier Quality Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is seeking a talented and experienced Senior Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) to join our SQE team. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the highest quality of NVIDIA boards and networking switch products. As a Senior SQE, you will have the opportunity to work closely with NVIDIA's suppliers and manufacturing partners to develop and implement outstanding quality programs for PCBAs, system boards, and networking switches. Your primary responsibility will be to represent NVIDIA's supplier quality interests, collaborating with internal engineering and operations teams to improve product quality, reliability, manufacturing performance, and supplier execution.
You will work closely with teams such as hardware engineering, product engineering, manufacturing engineering, product quality engineering, operations, and commodity management to drive continuous improvement. Additionally, you will be responsible for monitoring and reporting supplier quality performance and driving corrective and preventive actions.

What you'll be doing:
- Responsible to lead end-to-end supplier quality activities for PCBAs, system boards, and networking switch products.

- Drive supplier quality activities throughout the product lifecycle, including supplier readiness, NPI, qualification, production ramp, and sustaining phases.

- Collaborate with engineering organizations to investigate and resolve board- and system-level failures, including electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, and component-related issues.

- Lead failure investigations, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and preventive actions using structured problem-solving methodologies.

- Lead supplier and manufacturing process audits to ensure compliance with NVIDIA quality requirements and industry standards.

- Monitor supplier quality performance using quality metrics and statistical methods, identify improvement opportunities, and drive continuous quality improvement programs.

- Work with suppliers to improve manufacturing processes, increase yield, reduce defects, strengthen process controls, and improve overall product quality.

What we need to see:
- MS or BS in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent experience, with 8+ years of relevant experience in supplier quality, manufacturing, or the electronics industry.

- Professional knowledge of PCB/PCBA manufacturing processes, including SMT, reflow, soldering, inspection, and board assembly.

- Solid understanding of electronics manufacturing, component quality, workmanship requirements, and process controls.

- In-depth knowledge of quality and reliability concepts, including qualification, reliability testing, and failure analysis.

- Familiarity with board- and component-level failure analysis techniques, including X-ray, cross-sectioning, D&P, thermal analysis, and electrical fault isolation.

- Supplier quality management experience and knowledge of problem-solving methodologies, including 8D, 5-Why, FMEA, and SPC.

- Experience leading supplier corrective actions and root-cause investigations for manufacturing and field-quality issues.

- Ability to analyze quality and manufacturing data, identify trends, and drive improvement actions.

- Self-motivated, dedicated, and able to work with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.

- Proficiency in written and spoken English, with excellent communication skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
- Experience with networking switches, servers, or DataCenter hardware products.

- Knowledge of high-speed networking technologies, including Ethernet, switch ASICs, optical modules, and high-speed connectors.

- Experience working with CMs, ODMs, PCB suppliers, and electronic component suppliers.

- Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and mechanical drawings.

- Familiarity with industry standards and quality practices such as IPC-A-610, JEDEC standards, AQL sampling, and other relevant quality and reliability requirements.

- Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional supplier quality initiatives and drive sustainable improvements.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers, and we have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. Due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class teams are rapidly growing, so if you're creative and autonomous with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.
